# Setup

## Load dependencies

```{r}
library(BiocManager)
library(tximport)
library(org.Mm.eg.db)
library(AnnotationDbi)
library(DESeq2)
library(msigdbr)
library(GSVA)
library(progeny)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(tibble)
library(ggplot2)
library(ggpubr)
library(viridis)
library(here)
```

## Set seed to improve reproducibility

```{r}
set.seed(123)
```

## Create file structure

```{r}
dirs <- c(
  "bulkRNAseq_CHCA/data",
  "bulkRNAseq_CHCA/outs"
)

lapply(
  dirs,
  \(d) dir.create(here(d),
                  recursive = TRUE,
                  showWarnings = FALSE)
)
```

# Format data objects

## Retrieve RNA-seq files (download "quant.genes.sf" files from GEO#: GSM10180842)

## Add files to bulkRNAseq_CHCA/data directory

```{r}
# untar the folder
untar(
  tarfile = here("bulkRNAseq_CHCA", "data", "GSE353685_RAW.tar"),
  exdir = here("bulkRNAseq_CHCA", "data")
)

# create list of files
files <- list.files(
  here("bulkRNAseq_CHCA", "data"),
  pattern = "quant\\.genes\\.sf\\.gz$",
  recursive = TRUE,
  full.names = TRUE
)

# Extract sample names: A1, A2, B1, C1, etc.
sample_names <- sub(
  "^GSM[0-9]+_([^_]+)_.*",
  "\\1",
  basename(files)
)
names(files) <- sample_names

# Order samples correctly
sample_order <- c("A1","A2","A3","A4",
                  "B1","B2","B3","B4",
                  "C1","C2","C3")

files <- files[match(sample_order, names(files))]

length(files)
```

## Add sample metadata

```{r}
sample_table <- data.frame(
  sample = sample_order,
  group = c(
    rep("Young", 4),
    rep("Aging", 4),
    rep("CHCA_Aging", 3)
  )
)

# designate "group" based on age and treatment
sample_table$group <- factor(
  sample_table$group,
  levels = c("Young", "Aging", "CHCA_Aging")
)

rownames(sample_table) <- sample_table$sample

all(rownames(sample_table) == names(files))
```

## Create DEseq2 object

```{r}
txi <- tximport(
  files,
  type = "salmon",
  txOut = TRUE
)

dds <- DESeqDataSetFromTximport(
  txi = txi,
  colData = sample_table,
  design = ~ group
)
```

# Preprocess data (filter/transform)

## Filter low-expressing genes

```{r}
cat("Genes before filtering:", nrow(dds), "\n")
keep <- rowSums(counts(dds) >= 10) >=2 #the gene needs to be expressed in at least 2 samples
dds <- dds[keep, ]
cat("Genes after filtering:", nrow(dds), "\n")

# Genes before filtering: 55335 
# Genes after filtering: 19476 

#Number of genes before/after filtering is expected for bulk RNA-seq. Still good sequencing depth with ~20k final genes.
```

## Perform variance stabilization transformation

```{r}
vsd <- vst(dds, blind = FALSE)
vsd_mat <- assay(vsd)
```

## Change ENSMBL IDs to gene symbol

```{r}
# map gene names
gene_ids <- gsub("\\..*", "", rownames(vsd_mat))

gene_symbols <- mapIds(
  org.Mm.eg.db,
  keys = gene_ids,
  column = "SYMBOL",
  keytype = "ENSEMBL",
  multiVals = "asNA"
)

# assign directly to rownames
rownames(vsd_mat) <- gene_symbols

# remove ambiguous mapping
vsd_mat <- vsd_mat[!is.na(rownames(vsd_mat)), ]

# pool duplicates
vsd_mat <- as.data.frame(vsd_mat) %>%
  tibble::rownames_to_column("symbol") %>%
  group_by(symbol) %>%
  summarise(across(where(is.numeric), mean), .groups = "drop") %>%
  tibble::column_to_rownames("symbol") %>%
  as.matrix()
```

# Explore data

## Slc16ae/MCT4 expression (Figure 6G)

```{r}
gene_use <- "Slc16a3"

expr_df <- data.frame(
  sample = colnames(vsd_mat),
  group = sample_table[colnames(vsd_mat), "group"],
  Expression = as.numeric(vsd_mat[gene_use, ])
)

expr_df$group <- factor(
  expr_df$group,
  levels = c("Young", "Aging", "CHCA_Aging"),
  labels = c("Young", "Aging", "Aging\nCHCA-treated")
)

group_colors <- c(
  "Young" = "#4C78A8",
  "Aging" = "#F58518",
  "Aging\nCHCA-treated" = "#54A24B"
)

p_G <- ggplot(expr_df, aes(x = group, y = Expression, fill = group)) +
  geom_boxplot(width = 0.55, alpha = 0.75, outlier.shape = NA,
               color = "black", linewidth = 0.35) +
  geom_jitter(aes(color = group), width = 0.12, size = 2.4, alpha = 0.95) +
  stat_compare_means(
    comparisons = list(c("Young", "Aging"),
                       c("Aging", "Aging\nCHCA-treated")),
    method = "wilcox.test",
    label = "p.format",
    size = 3,
    step.increase = 0.12
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = group_colors) +
  scale_color_manual(values = group_colors) +
  labs(
    title = expression(italic(Slc16a3)~"(MCT4)"),
    x = "",
    y = "Normalized Expression (VST)"
  ) +
  theme_classic(base_size = 12, base_family = "Times New Roman") +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", hjust = 0.5, size = 12),
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1, size = 10),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 10),
    legend.position = "none"
  )

p_G
```

## GO pathways of interest (Figure 6H)

### Download GO pathway genes

```{r}
msig_go <- msigdbr(
  species = "Mus musculus",
  collection = "C5",
  subcollection = "GO:BP"
)

pathway_sets <- list(
  Inflammation = msig_go %>%
    filter(gs_name == "GOBP_CYTOKINE_PRODUCTION_INVOLVED_IN_INFLAMMATORY_RESPONSE") %>%
    pull(gene_symbol) %>%
    unique(),
  
  Microglia = msig_go %>%
    filter(gs_name == "GOBP_MICROGLIAL_CELL_ACTIVATION_INVOLVED_IN_IMMUNE_RESPONSE") %>%
    pull(gene_symbol) %>%
    unique()
)

pathway_sets <- lapply(pathway_sets, function(x) intersect(x, rownames(vsd_mat)))
```

## Plot pathway variation (GSVA)

```{r}
gsva_param <- gsvaParam(
  exprData = as.matrix(vsd_mat),
  geneSets = pathway_sets,
  kcdf = "Gaussian"
)

gsva_scores <- gsva(gsva_param)

gsva_df <- as.data.frame(t(gsva_scores))
gsva_df$sample <- rownames(gsva_df)
gsva_df$group <- sample_table[gsva_df$sample, "group"]

gsva_long <- gsva_df %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = names(pathway_sets),
    names_to = "Pathway",
    values_to = "GSVA_score"
  )

bubble_gsva <- gsva_long %>%
  group_by(group, Pathway) %>%
  summarise(
    mean_score = mean(GSVA_score, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

bubble_gsva$group <- factor(
  bubble_gsva$group,
  levels = c("Young", "Aging", "CHCA_Aging"),
  labels = c("Young", "Aging", "Aging\nCHCA-treated")
)

bubble_gsva$Pathway <- factor(
  bubble_gsva$Pathway,
  levels = c("Inflammation", "Microglia")
)

p_H <- ggplot(bubble_gsva, aes(x = group, y = Pathway)) +
  geom_point(
    aes(size = abs(mean_score), fill = mean_score),
    shape = 21,
    color = "black",
    stroke = 0.35,
    alpha = 0.95
  ) +
  scale_fill_gradient2(
    low = "navy",
    mid = "white",
    high = "firebrick",
    midpoint = 0,
    name = "Mean GSVA score"
  ) +
  scale_size_continuous(
    range = c(2.5, 9),
    name = "Mean GSVA"
  ) +
  theme_classic(base_size = 12, base_family = "Times New Roman") +
  labs(
    title = "Mean GSVA",
    x = "",
    y = ""
  ) +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", hjust = 0.5, size = 11),
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1, size = 10),
    axis.text.y = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1, size = 10),
    legend.title = element_text(size = 7),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 6)
  )

p_H
```

# PROGENy signaling pathway activity (Figure 6I)

```{r}
progeny_scores <- progeny(
  expr = as.matrix(vsd_mat),
  scale = TRUE,
  organism = "Mouse",
  top = 500
)

progeny_df <- as.data.frame(progeny_scores)
progeny_df$sample <- rownames(progeny_df)
progeny_df$group <- sample_table[progeny_df$sample, "group"]

progeny_long <- progeny_df %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = -c(sample, group),
    names_to = "Pathway",
    values_to = "Activity"
  )

progeny_bubble <- progeny_long %>%
  group_by(group, Pathway) %>%
  summarise(
    mean_activity = mean(Activity, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

progeny_bubble$group <- factor(
  progeny_bubble$group,
  levels = c("Young", "Aging", "CHCA_Aging"),
  labels = c("Young", "Aging", "Aging\nCHCA-treated")
)

progeny_bubble$Pathway <- dplyr::recode(
  progeny_bubble$Pathway,
  "Trail" = "TRAIL",
  "TNFa" = "TNFα",
  "TGFb" = "TGFβ",
  "PI3k" = "PI3K",
  "P53" = "p53",
  "NFkB" = "NF-κB"
)

p_I <- ggplot(progeny_bubble, aes(x = group, y = Pathway)) +
  geom_point(
    aes(size = abs(mean_activity), fill = mean_activity),
    shape = 21,
    color = "white",
    stroke = 0.6,
    alpha = 0.95
  ) +
scale_fill_gradient2( #change from viridis and make sure centered on zero to more accurately relect up/down reg
  low = "navy",
  mid = "white",
  high = "firebrick",
  midpoint = 0
) +
  scale_size_continuous(
    range = c(2.5, 8),
    name = "Absolute pathway\nactivity"
  ) +
  guides(
    size = guide_legend(
      override.aes = list(
        color = "black",
        fill = "grey85"
      )
    )
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12, base_family = "Times New Roman") +
  labs(
    title = "PROGENy-Inferred Signaling Pathway Activity",
    x = "",
    y = ""
  ) +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", hjust = 0.5, size = 12),
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1, size = 10),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 10),
    panel.grid.major.x = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    legend.title = element_text(size = 8),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 7)
  )

p_I
```

# Save figures

```{r}
ggsave(file.path(here("bulkRNAseq_CHCA", "outs"), "Figure6G_Slc16a3_MCT4.png"),
       p_G, width = 4, height = 4, dpi = 300)

ggsave(file.path(here("bulkRNAseq_CHCA", "outs"), "Figure6H_GSVA_inflammation_microglia.png"),
       p_H, width = 4.5, height = 4, dpi = 300)

ggsave(file.path(here("bulkRNAseq_CHCA", "outs"), "Figure6I_PROGENy_pathway_activity.png"),
       p_I, width = 6, height = 6, dpi = 300)

list.files(here("bulkRNAseq_CHCA", "outs"))
```
